events.title: piero pirupa (Italy/catch & release/nonstop) - long weekend
events.description: #block-1dd91caae6858dd06195 { --opacity: 100%; --translate-x: 0px; --translate-y: 0px; --rotation: 0deg; --scale-x: 100%; --scale-y: 100%; --skew-x: 0deg; --skew-y: 0deg; --origin-x: 50%; --origin-y: 50%; --block-transform: none; opacity: var(--opacity, 1); transform: var(--block-transform); transform-origin: var(--origin-x) var(--origin-y); } Piero Pirupa Italy is known worldwide for creating and exporting some of the finest things life has to offer and the talented musical maestro who goes by the name Piero Pirupa can definitely to be included in that illustrious list. He’s an artist that has found the perfect fusion between House and Techno, balancing his sound in a zone that never falls to hit the spot. A producer that is renowned for calling on influences from across multiple genres, in and out of popular dance music, creating a unique and formidable blend that has become his unmistakable calling card. He’s a DJ that has an unforgettable presence on stage and just as much charisma off it. A professional that has an incredible work ethic and always strives to offer his very best at all times – this is the formula that has been catapulting him through the ranks at breakneck speed. Piero has grown into a talent that is just as at home in front of thousands of expecting fans as he is simply in the studio tinkering with his next masterpiece. He’s a natural, one that puts in the hard graft but instinctively creates and performs, which is why he’s so often found amongst the chart topping tracks and within the line-ups of sell out events. Most recently he’s been hitting the stratospheric high notes - #1 in the Global Beatport Chart for a staggering 8 weeks with his take in Pink Floyd’s “The Wall” titled “We Don’t Need” which has so far totalled over 30 million streams. #1 Global Beatport Chart for 4 weeks with Piero’s version of Rozalla’s “Everybody’s Free” which again, has amassed over 20 million streams and was the most selling Tech House track of 2021 on Beatport. He is currently boasting a Spotify Monthly Listener total of over 1.5 million, which is an astonishing achievement in today’s highly competitive and saturated industry. Unsurprisingly, Piero is signed to some of the most famous and successful labels around, including – Spinnin, Defected, Toolroom, Repopulate Mars, Catch & Release, Drumcode, REALM, Solotoko, Sola, Relief, Musical Freedom and Crosstown Rebels. He’s an in demand remixer and has been called on by the likes of Dimitri Vegas & Like Mike, David Guetta, Claptone, Junior Jack, Deep Dish and one of the Gods of Acid Jazz – the internationally celebrated and award winning, Jamiroquai. When it comes to hitting the road, Piero has covered almost every corner of it. He’s graced the decks of Ultra Music Festival Miami & Seoul, Creamfields Liverpool, Hi Ibiza, Pacha Ibiza & Barcelona, Amnesia Ibiza, Space Miami, Elrow in Barcelona, Studio 338 in London, DayTrip Los Angeles, Exchange Los Angeles, Fabrik Madrid, Lost Beach Ecuador, Espacio Riesco Chile, and many more – naming just a handful of the standout gigs he’s been part of.
